question: What kind of diet does an adolescent require to develop a healthy reproductive system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nutritionally well-balanced**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most comprehensive and accurate answer is **Nutritionally well-balanced**. While the other options are important components, a truly healthy reproductive system requires a balanced approach.
 
• **Nutritionally well-balanced:**
 
 
• Adolescence is a crucial period for growth and development, including the reproductive system.
 
• A well-balanced diet provides all the essential nutrients needed for this development.
 
• This includes macronutrients (carbohydrates, proteins, and fats) and micronutrients (vitamins and minerals).
